name: Abrams
playstyle: Abrams has the bulk and sustain to lead from the front, often running into the middle of his foes and watching them scatter. If his enemies waste their fire on him, his backline teammates can lay out damage with impunity.

abilities.name: Siphon Life
abilities.quip: Drain health from nearby enemies
abilities.desc: Drain health from nearby enemies, dealing [Spirit D P S] and [Healing] for a portion of the damage dealt.
abilities.t3: +{s:Radius}m Radius and +{s:DPS} DPS with improved Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Shoulder Charge
abilities.quip: Charge into the fray, dragging enemies along
abilities.desc: Charge forward, [Pulling] enemies you hit. Pushing a hero into a wall applies [Stun]. If you collide with a hero you move faster during your charge.
abilities.t3: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown On Hero Collide: +{s:WeaponDamageBonus} Weapon Damage for {s:WeaponPowerIncreaseDuration}s

abilities.name: Infernal Resilience
abilities.quip: Regenerate some of the damage you receive
abilities.desc: Gain bonus defensive attributes. Taking damage grants temporary [Regen] for a portion of the damage taken.
abilities.t3: +{s:StatusResistancePercent}% Debuff Resist and +{s:RegenIncomingDamagePercent}% Damage Regenerated

abilities.name: Seismic Impact
abilities.quip: Smash into enemies from above, stunning them
abilities.desc: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing [Spirit Damage] and applying [Stun].
abilities.t3: On cast, become Unstoppable for {s:ImmunityDuration}s and +{s:ImpactRadius}m Impact Radius

abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
abilities.desc: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.
abilities.t1: Gain +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate and +{s:BonusBulletSpeedPercent}% Bullet Speed for {s:BuffDuration}s
abilities.t2: On Player Hit: +{s:StaminaToRestore} stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit
abilities.t3: Can be Recast within {s:RecastTime}s

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.desc: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist. Press to select a target. Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.
abilities.t3: Gain {s:TargetLifesteal}% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for {s:TargetLifestealDuration}s

abilities.name: Flawless Advance
abilities.desc: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage. Press to re-cast.
abilities.t2: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown. Gain +{s:BulletResist}% Bullet Resist during lunge
abilities.t3: +{s:PerfectDamage} Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling. Increased lunge speed & distance.

abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn
abilities.desc: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. Hold or to delay the cast.

abilities.name: Threadsap
abilities.quip: Threadsap
abilities.desc: Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing [Spirit Damage] and stealing enemy [Spirit], increased in effectiveness for Baba. While holding stolen [Spirit], Baba deals [Bonus Spirit Damage] with every bullet.
abilities.t3: +{s:AbilityCharges} Charge On Hit: Pull enemies {s:PullDistance}m

abilities.name: Granny Long Legs
abilities.quip: Granny Long Legs: jump high and kick anyone nearby with spirit-charged legs.
abilities.desc: Your bench's legs extend, granting [Bonus Move Speed], higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance. Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back. Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies [Knock Up], [Slow], and deals [Spirit Damage]. Hold to charge a high jump, release to jump.
abilities.t3: +{s:MeleeResist}% Resists +{s:MeleeLifesteal}% Melee Lifesteal

abilities.name: Baba's Brew
abilities.quip: Brew Baba's special pot of tea, then throw it to ignite or silence enemies, or shield allies
abilities.desc: Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time between a soothing [Combat Barrier], [Silence], or scalding burn that deals [Spirit D P S] and reduces [Spirit Resist]. Press to pause or resume brewing.
abilities.t3: +{s:BrewEffectiveness}% Brew Effectiveness

abilities.name: Feed The Birds
abilities.desc: Cover targets in front of you with bread, adding a stacking [Slow] . When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing [Spirit Damage] and hexing each target into a pigeon, increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.
abilities.t3: +{s:MaxDamage} Max Damage +{s:MaxDamage_scale} Spirit Scaling +{s:MaxPigeonDuration}s Max Duration

name: Bebop
role: Hooks an enemy for a knockout combo
playstyle: Bebop can string together his abilities in many different ways. Disrupting enemy positions, saving an ally or dealing bursts of damage. When the situation doesn't require subtlety his giant laser still solves many problems.

abilities.name: Exploding Uppercut
abilities.quip: Punch someone away from you
abilities.desc: Deal [Melee Damage] to nearby enemies and apply [Knock Back]. When they land, they deal [Spirit Damage] and apply [Reduced Fire Rate] to other nearby enemies. Exploding Uppercut can be used on allies.
abilities.t2: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +{s:BuffBaseWeaponPct}% weapon damage for {s:BuffDuration}s
abilities.t3: On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restores +{s:MissingHPHeal}% of your missing health

abilities.name: Sticky Bomb
abilities.quip: Plant a bomb on an enemy
abilities.desc: Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing [Spirit Damage] to nearby enemies. If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb. Stacks diminish by half after {s:OnHitDiminish} hits and {s:OnKillDiminish} kills
abilities.t3: On Cast: +{s:MovementSpeedBonus}m Move Speed and +{s:StatusResistancePercent}% Debuff Resistance for {s:MovementSpeedBonusDuration}s

abilities.name: Grapple Arm
abilities.quip: Pull in a target to you
abilities.desc: Launch out a mechanical hand that [Pulls] the first character it hits, reeling them in. Grapple Arm can be used on allies.

abilities.name: Hyper Beam
abilities.quip: Unleash a massive damaging beam
abilities.desc: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals [Spirit Damage] and applies [Slow].
abilities.t3: Hyper Beam heals {s:hero_name} for {s:BeamLifesteal}% of its damage on Heroes. {s:BeamLifestealNonHeroPercent}% on non-hero

abilities.name: Bashdown
abilities.desc: Slam your bat into the ground, [Pulling] enemies down and dealing [Melee Damage]. The slam creates a shockwave that deals [Spirit Damage] and applies [Knock Up].
abilities.t3: {s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge}s Charge Time Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

abilities.name: Rising Ram
abilities.desc: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

abilities.name: Blasted
abilities.desc: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for {s:BulletDamageAmpDuration}s.
abilities.t2: +1 Bashdown Charge on use and +{s:BulletDamageAmp}% Wrecked Bullet Amp
abilities.t3: +{s:MaxHealthMelee} Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling

abilities.name: Chain Gang
abilities.desc: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy [Slow] when they pull on the chain. After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal [Spirit Damage]. The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.
abilities.t3: +{s:AbilityCastRange}m Range +{s:UnstoppablePerHero}s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

name: Calico
playstyle: Calico uses the shadows to her advantage, weaving in and out of combat to hunt down her enemies one by one.

abilities.name: Gloom Bombs
abilities.quip: Throw out cluster bombs
abilities.desc: Throw a cluster of bombs that detonate after a delay, dealing [Spirit Damage]. Enemies hit by multiple bombs take {s:MultiHitPenaltyPercentage}% damage.
abilities.t2: Per Bomb Touch : {s:MeleeResistReduction}% Melee Resist for {s:MeleeResistReductionDuration}s

abilities.name: Leaping Slash
abilities.quip: Dash forward and slash enemies
abilities.desc: Dash forward before slashing all enemies in a circle, dealing [Melee Damage]. If the ability hits at least one hero, [Heal] a small amount of health.
abilities.t3: +{s:ImpactDamage} Damage & On Hero Hit: {s:CooldownRefundPercent}% Cooldown Refund

abilities.name: Ava
abilities.quip: Take control of Ava
abilities.desc: Turn to shadows and possess Ava. You gain [Bonus Move Speed] that increases over time, and become hidden on the minimap. Taking damage from an enemy hero resets your bonus move speed and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
abilities.t3: Gain Damage Amp over time, up to {s:OutgoingDamagePercent}%. Lingers for {s:DamageAmpDuration}s

abilities.name: Return to Shadows
abilities.quip: Turn to Shadows, gaining movespeed and dealing delayed damage
abilities.desc: Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining [Bonus Move Speed], and dealing [Spirit Damage]. After a delay, return from the shadows, dealing [Spirit Damage] again.
abilities.t3: On Completion: Heal for {s:HealAmount} and refund all ability cooldowns

abilities.name: Light Eater
abilities.desc: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take [Spirit Damage] when attacked by {s:hero_name} and provides her spirit lifesteal.
abilities.t3: +{s:Damage} Damage and Increased Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Dazzling Trick
abilities.desc: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
abilities.t2: +{s:CombatBarrier} Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
abilities.t3: +{s:DebuffDuration} Silence Duration and {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

abilities.name: Radiant Daggers
abilities.desc: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals [Spirit Damage] to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

abilities.name: Shining Wonder
abilities.desc: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals [Spirit Damage] and applies [Slow] and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
abilities.t3: +{s:MaxBounces} Max Bounces and {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown

abilities.name: Strix Salvo
abilities.desc: Launch a salvo of spirit missiles that lodge into the ground along a line. The missiles explode after a delay or upon detecting an enemy, dealing [Spirit Damage] and marking the target. Shooting a marked enemy with a charged shot consumes a mark to deal [Bonus Spirit Damage] and apply a fading [Slow]. Hold and drag to select the angle.
abilities.t3: +{s:MarksTotal} Missiles, Longer Range, and Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Chimera Mk1
abilities.desc: Hold to fly, building up heat. When max heat is reached, your jetpack will begin to overheat. Overheating: After a short delay, dive to the ground. Upon impact, create an explosion that deals damage and launches you and nearby enemies. If no hero is hit, you stun yourself. Press to dive early. Cooling Down: After overheating, the jetpack cannot be used until it fully cools down. Slows affect you while airborne. You always explode on death.
abilities.t2: On Hero Hit: Heal and take no self damage
abilities.t3: On Hero Hit: -{s:OverheatLockoutDurationReductionOnPlayerHitPercent}% Cooldown and +{s:ExplosionDamage} Spirit Damage

abilities.name: Jettison Fuel
abilities.desc: Spray fuel dealing [Weapon D P S] and shredding [Bullet Resist], building up to a huge backblast that deals [Spirit Damage] and knocks you backwards. Vents the jetpack when dealing damage.
abilities.t2: +{s:ScorchDamage} Burst Damage On Backblast Hit: +{s:BonusFireRate}% Fire Rate for {s:BuffDuration}s
abilities.t3: {s:BulletResistReduction}% Bullet Resist Shred On Backblast Hit: Apply a Mark

abilities.name: Close The Deal
abilities.desc: Grab an enemy and give them a hands-on demonstration, flying high into the air before crashing back to the ground. You and the participant take [Spirit D P S] while falling and [Spirit Damage] upon impact. Damage is increased to enemies under {s:LowHealthEnemyThresholdPct}% health.
abilities.t3: +{s:StunDuration}s Stun +{s:DamagePerMeter} Damage / Meter

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.desc: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing [Spirit Damage]. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus [Melee Damage].
abilities.t3: Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage Silences enemies for {s:DebuffDuration}s if close range

abilities.name: Stalker's Mark
abilities.desc: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing [Spirit D P S]. While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.
abilities.t3: +{s:DotHealthPercent}% Bleed and {s:HealAmpReceivePenaltyPercent}% Incoming Healing

abilities.name: Bloodscent
abilities.desc: Active: Accentuate your senses, revealing a trail that leads to nearby heroes. Isolated heroes leave a trail as they move, and emit their heartbeat from afar. You deal amplified damage against isolated heroes, and when isolated heroes die nearby you gain permanent [Weapon Damage].
abilities.t1: +{s:BonusMoveSpeed}m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
abilities.t2: On isolated hero death: Heal {s:HealOnKillPct}% of your missing health and restores {s:StaminaToRestore} Stamina

abilities.name: Eternal Night
abilities.desc: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. You gain [Bonus Sprint Speed].
abilities.t3: +{s:AbilityDuration}s Duration and +{s:MaxTargets} Max Target.

name: Dynamo
playstyle: Dynamo keeps himself and his allies healthy while waiting for his moment. Few things can warp a team fight more than a well-coordinated use of Singularity.

abilities.name: Kinetic Pulse
abilities.quip: Release a ground pulse that knocks enemies into the air
abilities.desc: Release an energy pulse that travels along the ground, dealing [Spirit Damage] and applying [Knock Up].
abilities.t2: On Hit: {s:BulletResistReduction}% Bullet Resist and -{s:SlowPercent}% Move Speed for {s:SlowDuration}s
abilities.t3: +{s:Damage} Damage and +{s:StompRange}m Cast Range

abilities.name: Quantum Entanglement
abilities.quip: Blink in and out of existence
abilities.desc: Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use. : Bring nearby allies with you.
abilities.t3: Reduces non-ult debuffs by {s:ReduceDebuffs}% Replenishes {s:ChargeReplenish} Charge

abilities.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
abilities.quip: Heal yourself and those around you
abilities.desc: While channeling, restore health over time to you and any allies nearby. You can dash and melee without breaking the channel.
abilities.t1: Aura provides +{s:MovementSpeedBonus}m Move Speed during channel
abilities.t3: Full move and ability use and additionally heals +{s:HealMaxHealthPercent}% of Max Health per second

abilities.name: Singularity
abilities.quip: Pull in and stun the enemy team
abilities.desc: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing [Spirit D P S], applying [Stun], and pulling in nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Jar of Dead
abilities.desc: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal [Spirit Damage] to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.
abilities.t1: Collecting death heals {s:HealPerPickup} health per pickup
abilities.t3: +{s:SkullCount} Deadheads +{s:SkullLifetime}s Deadhead Lifetime

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.desc: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take [Spirit Damage] and receive [Immobilize]. Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.
abilities.t3: +{s:GhoulCount} Ghouls Raised {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown +{s:ImmobilizeDuration}s Immobilize Duration

abilities.name: Essence Theft
abilities.desc: Your weapon steals [Weapon Damage] and [Spirit Resist] over time, up to a maximum amount per target.
abilities.t3: +{s:MaxStolenTargets} Max Steal Targets All Summons now apply Essence Theft

abilities.name: Borrowed Decree
abilities.desc: Innate: Abilities can summon Ghouls that shamble toward the enemy base, dealing [Melee Damage]. They explode when they approach a hero or objective, dealing [Spirit Damage] in an area and applying a brief [Slow] Active: Create a gravestone at a target location that summons Ghouls over time. Enemies can destroy the gravestone with two heavy melees.
abilities.t3: On Death: Deal +{s:CurrentHealthDamagePercentage}% Current Health as Damage

name: Grey Talon
playstyle: A cunning predator, Grey Talon uses a combination of deadly accuracy, traps, and clever positioning to bring down the toughest of opponents.

abilities.name: Charged Shot
abilities.quip: Charge up a long range shot
abilities.desc: Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold or to hold the shot.
abilities.t3: Improved damage scaling and {s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge}s Charge Delay

abilities.name: Rain of Arrows
abilities.quip: Jump high up in the air and unleash multishots
abilities.desc: Launches you high in the air, allowing you to glide slowly. While airborne, you gain Weapon Damage and multishot on your weapon. for reduced jump height. Press to cancel the glide.
abilities.t1: While airborne, +{s:WeaponDamageBonus} Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies {s:SlowPercent}% movement slow for {s:SlowDuration}s
abilities.t3: While airborne, +{s:BulletLifestealPercent}% Bullet Lifesteal, +{s:TechLifestealPercent}% Spirit Lifesteal and +{s:EvasionPercent}% Bullet Evasion

abilities.name: Spirit Snare
abilities.quip: Place a trap that restricts enemy movement
abilities.desc: Throw out a trap that begins to arm itself. Once armed, the trap will trigger when an enemy enters its radius, applying Curse and Movement Slow that interrupts, Silences, Disarms, and prevents item usage. Hit the trap with a Charged Shot to detonate early with increased radius.
abilities.t3: +{s:ImmobilizeTrap_CurseDuration}s Curse Duration and +{s:Radius}m Radius

abilities.name: Guided Owl
abilities.quip: Fly your owl to damage enemies from afar
abilities.desc: After {s:AbilityCastDelay}s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold to accelerate the owl. Press to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
abilities.t3: After hit, kills enemies that are below {s:LowHealthEnemyThresholdPct}% Health

name: Haze
playstyle: When Haze fixates on a target she can hold her own in a firefight. She prefers to create one sided exchanges, avoiding damage then picking off unsuspecting targets up close.

abilities.name: Sleep Dagger
abilities.quip: Put an enemy to sleep
abilities.desc: Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
abilities.t1: {s:BulletResistReduction}% Bullet Resist Reduction for {s:BulletResistReductionDuration}s on wake-up
abilities.t3: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown -{s:SlowPercent}% Move and Dash Speed for {s:DebuffDuration}s on wake-up

abilities.name: Smoke Bomb
abilities.quip: Fade out of sight
abilities.desc: Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.
abilities.t3: Dispels non-ult debuffs Grants +{s:BulletLifesteal}% Bullet Lifesteal for {s:BuffDuration}s

abilities.name: Fixation
abilities.quip: Deal increasing bullet damage to a target
abilities.desc: Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
abilities.t1: {s:ProcDamage} Spirit damage and {s:SlowPercent}% slow for {s:SlowDuration}s to target every {s:ProcDamageStackCount} stacks
abilities.t3: +{s:DamageBonusFixedPerStack}/ per Stack Scales with Weapon Damage

abilities.name: Bullet Dance
abilities.quip: Unleash a flurry of bullets around you
abilities.desc: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.
abilities.t3: +{s:EvasionPercent}% Evasion {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown

name: Holliday
playstyle: Holliday depends on her skills as a crack shot, shooting things she's bounced into the air. With good aim she can lay out heavy damage. Her movement skills let her isolate her enemies or beat a hasty retreat.

abilities.name: Powder Keg
abilities.quip: Throw a barrel that explodes when shot
abilities.desc: Throw a barrel that explodes after a delay, dealing [Spirit Damage], setting enemies on fire and applying [Knock Up]. The barrel can be detonated early by being shot, melee'd, or detonated by another barrel. The burn stacks, so overlapping barrels burn for their combined damage. Can be Alt-Cast to place the barrel in front of {s:hero_name}.
abilities.t3: +{s:ImpactDamage} Impact Damage +{s:DPS} Burn Damage per Second {s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge}s Charge Time Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Bounce Pad
abilities.quip: Send yourself and others flying
abilities.desc: Drop a bounce pad in the world that launches any hero. You explode on landing, dealing Damage to any nearby enemies. The explosion can only occur once per person per Bounce Pad.
abilities.t2: You and allies gain a +{s:SpeedOnLand}m/s move speed bonus for {s:BuffDuration}s on landing
abilities.t3: +{s:StompStunDuration}s Stomp Stun

abilities.name: Crackshot
abilities.quip: Deal bonus damage with headshots
abilities.desc: Headshots deal bonus Damage and applies a Fading Move Speed penalty. This effect can only occur when off cooldown. Cooldown is reduced by {s:CrackshotNPCCDReduction}% on NPC hits. Crackshot ignores range damage fall-off and does not apply to objectives.
abilities.t3: {s:AbilityCooldownPerHeadshot}s Cooldown on Hero Headshots. {s:AbilityCooldownPerHeadshotNPC}s on NPC Headshots

abilities.name: Spirit Lasso
abilities.quip: Grab an enemy and drag them behind you
abilities.desc: Throw out your lasso, dealing [Spirit Damage], [Pulling], and applying [Stun]. Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

name: Infernus
role: Lights up enemies and watches them burn
playstyle: Infernus has many ways to deal damage over time, burning foes before swooping in for the kill. Due to Infernus' blazing speed, his enemies won't be able to escape the flames.

abilities.name: Napalm
abilities.quip: Spew napalm that amplifies your damage
abilities.desc: Spew an incendiary mixture, dealing [Spirit Damage], applying [Slow], and coating targets in napalm.
abilities.t3: Napalm Effect: +{s:IncomingDamagePercentFromCaster}% Damage Taken and {s:HealAmpReceivePenaltyPercent}% Healing

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.quip: Blaze forward, leaving a flame trail in your wake
abilities.desc: Dash forward, gaining [Slow Resistance] while leaving a flaming trail that deals [Spirit D P S]. Hold while active to dash farther.
abilities.t3: Enable {s:AbilityCharges} Ability Charges with {s:AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge}s Recharge time

abilities.name: Afterburn
abilities.quip: Shoot enemies to set them on fire
abilities.desc: Weapon hits build up a burning effect, dealing [Spirit D P S]. Abilities refresh to the base burn duration and weapon hits extend it.
abilities.t3: +{s:AfterburnDurationMax}s Max Burn Duration

abilities.name: Concussive Combustion
abilities.quip: Stun all nearby enemies after a short delay
abilities.desc: Become a living bomb, dealing [Spirit Damage] and applying [Stun] to all nearby enemies after a delay. Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.
abilities.t3: +{s:StunDuration}s Stun Duration and +{s:Radius}m Radius

name: Ivy
role: Sets up a power duo with a lucky ally
playstyle: Ivy has disruptive combat tricks that slow and stun enemies. She's most effective when linking up with an ally, empowering her and her ally's guns as well as sharing heals.

abilities.name: Entangling Thorns
abilities.quip: Damage and slow enemies in the area
abilities.desc: Summon a patch of choking thorns that damages and slows enemies in its radius.
abilities.t2: +{s:Radius}m Radius and increased DPS Spirit scaling
abilities.t3: Enemies caught in thorns for {s:TimeToEntangle}s are Immobilized for +{s:EntangleDuration}s

abilities.name: Kudzu Connection
abilities.quip: Empower yourself and a nearby ally
abilities.desc: Connect with a nearby ally to gain bonuses, replicated healing, and ignore the move speed penalty while shooting. Receive 50% of Bonuses with no connection Connection requires line of sight.
abilities.t3: Ability is always active

abilities.name: Stone Form
abilities.quip: Turn into impervious stone and stun enemies nearby
abilities.desc: Turn yourself into impervious stone and smash into the ground, stunning and damaging enemies nearby. Heals you for a percentage of your max health.
abilities.t3: +{s:StunDuration}s Stun Duration and increased Damage spirit scaling

abilities.name: Air Drop
abilities.quip: Death from Above! Fly and drop an ally on enemies
abilities.desc: Grab an ally and take flight with them. Drop your ally to cause an explosion, dealing [Spirit Damage]. You and your ally gain increased Outgoing Damage when flying ends. Cooldown reduced by {s:CooldownReductionPctOnOthers}% when used on allies. Taking damage briefly disables using the ability. While lifted, your ally cannot attack and deals {s:AllyOutgoingDamagePercent}% damage.
abilities.t1: On Fly End : {s:AirDropBulletShield} Barrier to {s:hero_name} and ally that scales with Spirit
abilities.t3: Silence for {s:AirDropSilenceDuration}s on enemies hit. Increases damage and barrier scaling.

name: Kelvin
playstyle: Timely heals and splitting a teamfight properly is the difference between an easy victory or a ruinous defeat. Gliding around slowing enemies gives Kelvin's team the maneuvering advantage to make this happen.

abilities.name: Frost Grenade
abilities.quip: Damage and slow enemies
abilities.desc: Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that [Heals] allies and applies [Spirit Damage] and move speed reduction to enemies.
abilities.t2: {s:AbilityCooldown} Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
abilities.t3: +{s:Radius}m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

abilities.name: Ice Path
abilities.quip: Speed around on a floating path of ice
abilities.desc: {s:hero_name} creates a floating trail of ice and snow that gives movement bonuses to him and his allies. Kelvin gains {s:SlowResistancePercent}% slow resistance for the duration. Enemies can also walk on the floating trail. Press / to travel up or down while in Ice Path.
abilities.t1: +{s:MoveSpeedBonus}m Move Speed and +{s:BulletResist}% Bullet Resist for {s:hero_name} while on Ice Path
abilities.t3: +{s:BonusSpiritPct}% Spirit and +{s:BonusSpirit} Spirit for {s:hero_name} while on Ice Path

abilities.name: Arctic Beam
abilities.quip: Apply an escalating slow
abilities.desc: Shoot freezing cold energy out in front of you, damaging targets and progressively reducing their movement and fire rate the longer you sustain the beam on them. You have reduced move speed while using Arctic Beam. The beam may also claim Souls.
abilities.t1: -{s:MaxSlowPercent}% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
abilities.t3: {s:AbilityCooldown}s Cooldown and Fires {s:BeamSplitCount} additional Arctic Beams within {s:BeamSplit}m of the last target hit.

abilities.name: Frozen Shelter
abilities.quip: Create an impenetrable healing dome
abilities.desc: Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them. While in the dome, allies gain rapid [Regen] and enemies are slowed. Objectives become Invulnerable and Frozen under Frozen Shelter
